description: Set an input element's value using React-compatible method (native descriptor setter + input/change events). Auto-waits up to 5 seconds for the element. Works with regular inputs, textareas, and React controlled components.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element. Inside an iframe (cross-origin too): 'iframe#card >>> input[name=cardnumber]'

value.description: Value to set in the input field

name: browser_fill
